The '''Mynock virus''' was a [[Computer virus/Legends|computer virus]] developed by [[Corazon Industries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as a method of wiping out their competition, [[Nebula Consumables]]. It was first tested on the [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of [[Premier Provisions]].
